title: Checkout trust gap closed
imageAlt: A shopper reviewing an order on a laptop at home
summary: A fashion and D2C brand saw shoppers reach checkout and stop. We found the doubt and made the last step feel safe.

story.label: THE BRIEF
story.title: Steady traffic, flat checkout
story.text: A fashion and D2C brand had steady traffic and a healthy basket, yet checkout completion stayed flat. The team assumed the payment form was too long.

story.label: WHAT WE SAW
story.title: Doubt sat at three points
story.text: Observation and shopper interviews showed people pausing at the total, the return terms and the payment step. Each pause came from a quiet question about what happens if something goes wrong.

story.label: WHAT WE CHANGED
story.title: Three small, tested changes
story.text: We showed the total earlier, placed the return terms beside the button and kept the payment step familiar. Each change was tested against one agreed behaviour.

story.label: WHAT MOVED
story.title: Completion rose, questions fell
story.text: Checkout completion rose by 23% over the test period and support questions about returns fell. The team kept the changes and applied the same method to the product page.
